name: text-highlight
title: Text Highlight
description: TextHighlight primitive. Platform Reference: Modern Web Guidance (MWG: highlight-text-ranges)

taxonomy: A declarative text-search and keyword highlight container powered by the CSS Custom Highlight API (`::highlight()`).
Highlights search matches on the GPU compositor without mutating the DOM tree, splitting strings, or fragmenting screen reader announcements.
Adheres to WCAG 4.1.3 (Status Messages) by synchronizing visual highlights with an `aria-live="polite"` screen reader match announcer.
Styles matches using tokenized secondary container palette in globals.css: `::highlight(search-results) { background-color: var(--secondary-container); color: var(--on-secondary-container); }`

docs:
TextHighlight primitive.
Platform Reference: Modern Web Guidance (MWG: highlight-text-ranges)
TAXONOMY & USAGE:
- A declarative text-search and keyword highlight container powered by the CSS Custom Highlight API (`::highlight()`).
- Highlights search matches on the GPU compositor without mutating the DOM tree, splitting strings,
or fragmenting screen reader announcements.
- Adheres to WCAG 4.1.3 (Status Messages) by synchronizing visual highlights with an `aria-live="polite"`
screen reader match announcer.
- Styles matches using tokenized secondary container palette in globals.css:
`::highlight(search-results) { background-color: var(--secondary-container); color: var(--on-secondary-container); }`
